title: ABAP Analyser Findings
description: The insights the standalone /abap-analyser lane produces for a scanned SAP custom-code package, written to specs/brownfield/analyser-findings.json and consumed by /abap-brownfield, /readiness, and /seam-finder. Built entirely by the harness (Claude reasoning over the ADT read tools) — no TALOS/cloud dependency. Shape modeled on what a mature ABAP analyser emits (code graph + blast-radius + S/4-readiness + quality findings).

source_system.description: Identity of the SAP SOURCE system the analyser connected to (read-only), distinct from the DEV build tier.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the analyser wrote this artifact.

schema_version.description: Semver of the emitted document shape (§15.5). Consumers fail-closed (INDETERMINATE) on an unknown major.

source_hash.description: Run identity (§7): SHA-256 hex over the canonical (sorted, line-ending-normalized) source set.

config_hash.description: Run identity (§7): SHA-256 hex over target_release + registry SHAs + rule-pack version + exact @abaplint/core version + policy.

run_id.description: Run identity (§7): SHA-256 hex of source_hash + config_hash — the offline provenance + idempotent-cache key. Displayed truncated.

coverage_note.description: What the scan could and could not establish; note any object skipped or any ADT signal that came back data_available:false (never assume retirement from a missing signal).

findings.description: Static-analysis + quality findings, primarily from run_atc_check plus harness pattern checks. Models TALOS AbapFinding.

rule_id.description: ATC check id or harness rule id.

severity.description: ATC priority (priority-1 is a Clean-Core blocker under ABAP_CLEAN_CORE_DEVELOPMENT).

object.description: Object name the finding is in.

family.description: e.g. released-api, modification, invariant, performance, dynamic-sql.

enclosing_unit.description: Smallest containing METHOD/FORM/FUNCTION/MODULE (else the compilation-unit object) — the line-resilient anchor scope (conv #10).

normalized_snippet.description: Normalized flagged-statement text: whitespace-collapsed, keywords upper-cased, string literals verbatim (conv #10).

finding_id.description: Run identity (§7): SHA-256 hex of rule_id + object + enclosing_unit + normalized_snippet — the line-resilient exemption/ratchet anchor.

referenced_object.description: For registry-family findings (e.g. released-api): the SAP object the finding references, graded via the oracle (conv #17).

source_category.description: The finding's native family/category, persisted for curation (§3.B).

grade.description: Clean-core grade, routed total+disjoint by family (conv #17): registry families grade via the oracle on referenced_object, all others via severity.

atc_priority.description: ATC priority derived from grade (blocker->P1, warning->P2, advisory->P3, needs_review->none).

atcCheckId.description: Nearest ATC check id (§15.7 family map).

s4_readiness.description: S/4HANA / Clean-Core readiness, grounded on aws_abap_cb_get_migration_analysis per referenced object. Models TALOS S4ReadinessSummary.

s4_readiness_pct.description: % S/4-ready = (released A + classicAPI B) / total; classicAPI runs on S/4 on-prem. Empty -> 100 (nothing to migrate).

cloud_readiness_pct.description: % Cloud-ready = released A / total; only cloud-released APIs count. Empty -> 0 (nothing cloud-released). DISTINCT from s4_readiness_pct.

classic_api_hits.description: Level B (classicAPI) count — S/4-ready but not cloud-released.

metrics.description: Package-level codebase metrics for the Summary tab: LOC + object/file counts + customer-vs-SAP LOC split + TALOS size class + cyclomatic/nesting extremes + duplication + a Maintainability Index (SEI/Microsoft comment-adjusted formula over token-based Halstead volume, cyclomatic, LOC, comment ratio; bounded 0-100, analyser-defined UX score).

by_kind.description: compilation-unit count by CPG node kind.

cloud_readiness.description: Findings bucketed by clean-core grade (§3.C): blockers=D, warnings=C, advisories=B, needs_review=unknown. Per-finding detail stays in `findings` (join by grade).

code_health.description: Code-health dimension (§3.C): a package clean_core_grade (weakest node grade, §2) plus four 0-100 scores. clarity = mean of the cyclomatic sub-axis (100 - mean per-method penalty, linear from cc=10 to abaplint's max=20) and the LCOM sub-axis (100 - 100*mean Henderson-Sellers LCOM* over non-test classes); stability = 100*(1 - mean Martin main-sequence distance D=|A+I-1|) over the depended-upon core (compilation-unit objects with Ca>0; I=Ce/(Ca+Ce) instability, A=abstractness [interface=1, class=abstract-method fraction, else 0]; by-design entry points with no dependents excluded); performance = % of compilation-unit objects free of performance-family findings; compound = mean(clarity, stability, performance). Only clarity is spec-formulated; the rest are analyser-defined deterministic scores (operator-approved 2026-07-09), so the numbers are a UX target, not a numeric oracle.

debt.description: Tech-debt scoring (§3.C Debt tab): per-symbol 0-1 composite over 10 signals — TALOS debt_scorer structure/weights/anchors (Appendix A), ADAPTED to our real metrics (complexity=McCabe, lcom_score=Henderson-Sellers LCOM*, duplication=clone findings) where TALOS forces 0/proxy. Composite = weighted sum of the first 6 signals only (0.20 size_ratio + 0.10 function_density + 0.20 avg_function_length + 0.20 coupling + 0.20 complexity + 0.10 duplication); signals 7-10 are structural, reported but not weighted. Symbol = compilation-unit object; scores sorted by score desc.

signals.description: The 10 signals, each 0-1: size_ratio, function_density, avg_function_length, coupling, complexity, duplication, interface_presence, test_double_ready, lcom_score, structural_quality.

layers.description: Topological layering of CPG nodes (§3.C): entry (no incoming dependency), internal (called), data (tables).

boundaries.description: Inbound system boundaries (§3.C): compilation-unit objects called into from a different object.

graph.description: Call/uses dependency graph derived from the pulled ABAP source (parsed by the analyser). Models TALOS GraphNodeDict/GraphEdgeDict. Every edge must be traceable to a source read.

kind.description: canonical CPG node kind (matches the analyser NodeKind union in docs/ANALYSER_ARCHITECTURE.md #3 C2)

namespace.description: Z/Y = customer; registered = /NS/ vendor namespace; sap = SAP standard.

clean_core_posture.description: DUAL-EMITTED (§15.5) from clean_core_grade via the crosswalk A->level-a, B/C->brownfield-mixed, D->classic; retained one minor for back-compat, then cutover.

clean_core_grade.description: Oracle clean-core Level (§15.5, replaces clean_core_posture): SAP nodes = own Level; customer nodes = weakest dependency Level (§2 cap); unknown for registry gaps.

rank.description: PageRank importance normalized to [0,1] (§3.C top_objects / §3.D priority_rank); most important object = 1.0.

kind.description: canonical CPG edge kind (matches the analyser EdgeKind union in docs/ANALYSER_ARCHITECTURE.md #3 C2)

evidence.description: the object + statement the edge was read from (traceability).

blast_radius.description: Per deprecated/at-risk object: who is affected if it changes. Models TALOS S4BlastRadiusEntry.

modernization_plan.description: Modernization plan (§3.D): per customer compilation-unit object — target artifact, effort tier, priority rank, migration complexity, and its transformation work-list — in transport-safe order. Reproduces TALOS enrich_node_metadata + transport sequence (reference §10 / Appendix B) over the analyser's real debt + PageRank + AST inputs. Scope = customer (Z/Y) compilation units; SAP objects are dependencies, not targets.

kind.description: CPG node kind of the compilation unit (class/report/function/interface/table/cds/behavior).

modernization_target.description: Target artifact: RAP Business Object / Fiori Elements App / OData V4 Service / RAP Interface / CDS View Entity / Review Required.

effort_tier.description: XL if debt>0.7 or stmts>200; L if >0.5/>100; M if >0.3/>50; else S.

priority_rank.description: By normalized PageRank: P1>0.8, P2>0.5, else P3.

migration_complexity.description: 0-5: +1 each for dyn_call_ratio>0.3, cyclomatic>10, nesting>5, debt>0.6, and (no analogue in our node taxonomy) obj_type in {wdyn,wapa,enho}.

transformations.description: Per-object modernization work-list: the modernization-family findings on the object (raw abaplint style/naming lint excluded).

kind.description: Finding family (released-api, deprecation, clean-core, performance, modification, rap-odata, anti-pattern).

released_successor.description: Structured target API from the oracle for findings that reference a SAP object (else null).

namespace_summary.description: Customer vs SAP-standard breakdown and mixed-namespace warnings.

signals.description: Live-SAP usage/mod signals; each carries data_available so a missing signal is never read as 'unused/retired'.
